review_evidence: README states that HaskellSpec is an experimental mechanization of the Haskell 98/2010 language reports intended to give a formal, unambiguous language specification.

The HaskellSpec modules define source/target syntax, semantic types, environments, import/export and elaboration judgments, kinding relations, and checked metatheoretic properties such as kind-order reflexivity/transitivity/asymmetry.

Main.lean is only a `Not implemented` executable stub; book-report/HaskellReportMain.lean is Verso manual emission configuration; ContextFreeSyntax.lean and Introduction.lean are placeholder prose sections; Papers.lean contains only dummy bibliography examples. The substantive LexicalSyntax report and HaskellReport document root are retained.

rules.content_invariant: Every selected file was completely inspected: none owns Haskell syntax/semantic judgments or a checked result. HaskellSpec/**, the substantive LexicalSyntax report, and the HaskellReport document root remain searchable.
evidence: HaskellReportMain.lean only configures and invokes Verso manual emission.
ContextFreeSyntax.lean and Introduction.lean contain only placeholder headings/text.
Papers.lean contains three fabricated bibliography examples (`A Great Thesis`, `Grommulation of Flying Lambdas`) unrelated to the Haskell formalization.
rules.rationale: These exact files are executable/manual-generation scaffolding, empty placeholder report sections, or dummy bibliography examples around the retained Haskell formal specification.

summary: Retain the Haskell language-report mechanization and substantive report material while excluding only executable/manual scaffolding and placeholder/dummy report files.
